title: Acquirer: Custom Fleet; Target: Hertz Lease Limited

body_sections.Summary: Custom Fleet (owned by National Australia Bank) to acquire Hertz Leasing Ltd from Ford Motor Credit Company
body_sections.Market definition: Car fleet leasing and management services
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission concluded that the increase in Custom Fleet's market share would be minimal and it would continue to face strong competitors and customers with bargaining power in an expanding market.  On this basis, the Commission concluded that the proposed acquisition is not likely to result in a substantial lessening of competition.
